title: Relational background field formulation of discrete quantum gravity models: The case of $O(N)$ vector models in zero dimensions
summary: In a recent paper arxiv.org/abs/2609.21031, we have introduced the concept of a relational background field as a new approach to the renormalization group (RG) for discrete quantum gravity models, focusing on random matrix models. The proposed method offers the dual advantage of preserving the model's gauge symmetry (typically $U(N)$ or $O(N)$), whose breaking in conventional approaches has remained an open problem, and providing a more satisfactory treatment of the continuum or infrared (IR) limit.
